title: The Answer That Isn't on My CV
seoTitle: The Answer That Isn't on My CV | Faraz Ansari
description: A personal reflection on career uncertainty, building a future in Britain, visa sponsorship, ambition, faith and the human story behind a CV.
deck: On ambition, uncertainty, the search for opportunity, and learning that my worth cannot be decided by someone else's answer.
heroAlt: An illustrated CV with application details beside an illuminated open door, representing the human story beyond career credentials.
heroCaption: A CV records a career, but cannot hold the whole person behind it.
